heard.text: I've eaten berries: my recorded nutrition is 8 and toxicity 0. I have one hazelnut sample, but its nutrition and toxicity remain unknown to me. Does anyone have personally tested findings about hazelnuts?

records.fragment: {"id":"safe-food-and-observation","status":"completed","question":"Can nearby meadow roots support a practical food reserve while I develop reliable observation skills?","evidence":["One root meal at tick 3 realized 14 nutrition; known root toxicity is zero.","At tick 11, seven roots remain owned.","The tick 11 probe directly observed stock 12, growth 1.70051608, mature stage and ordinary soil with moisture 0.65."],"uncertainty":"One observation does not establish long-term productivity or future conditions.","goal":"Obtain safe food and perform a first mastered observation.","completedSteps":

records.value: Run the newly mastered whole-root exposure trial with a carried control, then inspect the actual decay comparison before deciding what to do with the exposed food.

value: Food-air-exposure-trial was personally mastered at tick 13; no trial result exists yet.
Expose only one root and reserve one same-stack carried control. Stay at the placement during the comparison interval.
Inspection measures decay, not dryness, preservation, contamination or safety. After inspection, review the actual batch identity and readings before stopping and retrieving it.

baseline.function: Read a current-world capability contract or retained personal record.
Offer a personally tested finding or independently accept an actual nearby offer.
Give a name of up to 60 characters to this place (empty subject) or to a visible object or nearby item; naming the same subject again replaces your name for it.

baseline.args: x: number, y: number, round: integer>=1, text

candidates.function: Lay whole units of your own food on open ground or an existing food surface to expose them to actual weather, optionally keeping a carried control from the same stack; inspect both

execution.progress: Each mode is one atomic round. The trial record (batch, control, placement, readings, rain rounds, last update) persists; exposure continues unattended without charge until stop, removal, spoilage or death.

details.costs: Study: 2 rounds. Start: inputStackId is the exact id of your own unspoiled, untreated berry or root stack (or food whose water composition is already represented); quantity whole units to expose; optional controlQuantity whole units of the same stack kept carried and reserved (together at most its whole units). Place at x,y (default your position) within 0.65 plus your body radius, or on supportId, an existing food surface in reach. One round and 1 + 0.5 x quantity energy; all checks run before any charge; walking there is a separate navigate. Inspect: your open trial, within reach of the batch; one round, 0.2 energy. Stop: one round, no energy. Taking the food back uses pickup at its own cost. No tool, fuel, cutting or material is used or made.
details.effects: Start separates the units and lays them, unowned, on a ground footprint of 0.04 per unit (firm ordinary ground inside the world, not water, wet bank or waterlogged ground, unobstructed, nothing else lying there) or on the support, and gives them the world food water record (assumed water fraction root 0.75, berry 0.85). Every later round the existing rules apply: whole food loses no water; rain on the uncovered surface adds 0.01 x rain x area water; decay continues at the ordinary rate for the temperature where the food lies and is never reset. The control ages normally while carried. So no dryness, preservation or safety status can be reached: they stay unverified; nutrition and toxicity are unchanged; contamination is not assessed. Anyone may pick up food lying in the world: taking part reduces the batch, taking all ends the trial. Inspect records elapsed rounds, quantities, decay at placement and now and per round for batch and control, their difference and rain on the batch, as an unverified personal record; water content is not measured. Spoilage under the existing rule or removal ends the trial; stop ends it and leaves the batch where it lies. Ending releases the control once; death ends it the same way. No refund, reward or comfort.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 6000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form. Paged records omit their per-record notes: concatenate all parts before parsing; continue with the same exact id. An entry marked inRetrieval is shown with at least the same content under the same id in this input's retrieval. observation.terrain rows are "y:x:cells" strings: each character of cells is the terrain kind of one visible cell, at x, x+1, ... in row y. abilities.baseline entries with id, function and args summarize interfaces you neither used in the last 25 rounds nor need now. args lists the arguments in order: a bare name is a string; otherwise its type with any bounds (number>=lo, integer<=hi, integer lo..hi, and a bare lo..hi is a number range) or its choices a|b; ? marks an optional argument and "" means none. An exact abilities query by id returns the complete contract, including references and string limits of 200 or more code units.

value.question: How does decay of one exposed whole root compare with a carried control over the same interval here?
evidence: Seven roots are owned at tick 11.
The available trial contract supports exposed and carried samples from the same stack.
The current location is ordinary soil with no observed local hazards.
value.uncertainty: No personal exposure trial has been performed. Actual decay differences and weather during the interval are unknown; water content and contamination are not measured by this trial.
value.goal: Learn the interface and obtain one paired decay observation using two roots.
value.missing: Personal mastery, placement and a later paired inspection.
value.next: Learn, place one root with one carried control, allow eight rest rounds, then inspect.
value.benefit: No trial benefit observed yet; the small sample limits food committed to investigation.
